title: Excluded top-level import graph watch roots
invariant: When the project root has a directory exclusion filter, an excluded top-level directory is not covered by a recursive watch, and an eligible included top-level directory is covered.
scope: Historical SourceWatcher constructor and start scheduling snippets. The Lean witness models the recursive coverage decision for a top-level child; it does not prove Python-to-Lean equivalence, nested exclusions, runtime delivery, thread counts, or performance.
